Figure 1:Overview ofSynthDCB.SynthDCBbuilds configurable executable worlds from reusable device capabilities across Home, Car, and Phone.
Agents interact with these worlds through device tools and are evaluated on tasks involving environment states, user preferences, and temporal dynamics.
The example shows coordinating an air conditioner with a washer cycle to reach Alex’s preferred temperature at the required time.

Figure 2:The system pipeline of world distillation and task construction. World distillation connects behavioral knowledge to executable capabilities, composed worlds, and validated tasks. A shared capability specification links discovery, execution, and task construction. Component checks drive bounded repair; reference replay validates task construction.
Figure 6:Failure cause statistics.Left: weighted counts;bottom right: normalized contribution within failures;upper right: case-wise agreement in a separate 200-case annotation audit.
Figure 8:RobotVacuum external knowledge, implementation code, and replayed cleaning states across L1-L3.
Figure 9:Mean Pass@1 by task family and subtype.
